title: Customer-Pay Repairs Cancellation Schedule: Restocking, Non-Returnable Parts, Labor Performed and Refund Timing
content:
Schedule to the cancellation terms of Customer-Pay Repairs. It lists, by service tier, the percentages and settings that price a cancelled job and the time allowed for refunding a deposit or overpayment.

| Service tier | Restocking fee on returnable parts already ordered (percent of the parts amount) | Share of non-returnable parts charged (percent) | Labor already performed is charged | Business days to refund a deposit or overpayment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paintless Dent Repair Service | 0 | 100 | Yes | 5 |
| Cosmetic Touch-Up Service | 15 | 100 | Yes | 5 |
| Bumper Refinish Service | 15 | 100 | Yes | 5 |
| Panel Repair Service | 20 | 100 | Yes | 5 |
| Customer-Pay Collision Service | 20 | 100 | Yes | 5 |
| Complete Refinish Service | 20 | 100 | Yes | 5 |

## Defined terms

- **Restocking fee**: Restocking fee on returnable parts already ordered when a job is cancelled (percent of the parts amount).
- **Non-returnable parts charged**: Share of non-returnable (special-order or painted) parts charged when a job is cancelled (percent).
- **Labor performed charged**: Whether labor already performed is charged when a job is cancelled during work (boolean).
- **Refund days**: Business days to refund a deposit or overpayment to the original method (integer).

## Notes

- Every tier charges 100 percent of non-returnable parts, charges labor already performed, and refunds within 5 business days.
- The restocking percentage is the one figure that varies: 0 for Paintless Dent Repair Service, 15 for Cosmetic Touch-Up Service and Bumper Refinish Service, 20 for the three higher tiers.
- Hypothetical returnable parts amount of 300.00: restocking fee of 0.00 at 0 percent, 45.00 at 15 percent, 60.00 at 20 percent.
